Database.//: Provider = InMemory (mock, default) or SqlServer (real existing member DB).

ConnectionStrings.//: AuthDb holds the auth-owned schema (auth.RefreshTokens). MemberDb hosts the SSO config proc (MEM_SP_SSO_Config). Both required when Database:Provider = SqlServer.

LobConnections.//: One connection string per LOB. Used by the Dapper repository to pick the member DB at login. Supply from Key Vault/secrets in production.

Jwt.//PrivateKeyPem: In production, inject a PKCS#8 RSA private key via secrets/Key Vault.

PasswordHashing.//: Match these to the EXACT scheme used by the existing database when you switch to SqlServer.

Sso.//: SSO feature (GET /api/v1/sso). SkipLobs = LOBs that get configuration back but no PingFederate hand-off (legacy SkipSSO:Lobs). HraAssessment replaces the legacy hard-coded LOB 2100 HRA minor/adult rule (legacy SSOAssessmentSettings).

PingFederate.//: OpenToken hand-off. AgentFilesPath holds the agent-config .txt files downloaded from the PingFederate admin console (legacy App_Data/AgentFiles); each SSO config row's AgentFileLocationPath names its file (e.g. hra-agent-config-qa.txt). Enabled=false falls back to the stub (configured URL only, no token).
